senses.definition: vb. call, proclaim, read (NH id., read aloud, read; Ph. קרא call; Arabic قَرَأَ read aloud, recite (the ‘Ḳorʾān’), القُرْآنُ the Ḳorʾān; Aramaic קְרָא, ܩܪܳܐ call, etc., so Old Aramaic קרא, Nab. id., Palm. id., קרה);—

Qal Pf. ק׳ Genesis 11:9 +, 3 fs. consec. וְקָרָאת Isaiah 7:14 (Ges§ 74 g); 2 ms. קָרָאתָ Judges 12:1 +, etc.; Impf. 3 ms. יִקְרָא Genesis 2:19 +; sf. יִקְרְאוֹ Jeremiah 23:6, -אֵהוּ Isaiah 41:2 +; 1 s. אֶקְרָא Deuteronomy 32:3 +, וָאֶקְרָאֶה I Samuel 28:15 (Ges§ 48 d NesMarg. 15); 3 fpl. וַתִּקְרֶאנָה Ruth 4:17(×2), וַתִּקְרֶאן Numbers 25:2; Numbers 25:2 fpl. תִּקְרֶאנָה Ruth 1:20, Ruth 1:21, etc.; Imv. ms. קְרָא Judges 7:3 +, sf. קְרָאֵנִי Psalms 50:15, etc.; Inf. cstr. קְרֹא I Samuel 3:6 +, קְרֹאות (Baer -אֹת) Judges 8:1 (Ges§ 74 h); sf. קָרְאִי Psalms 4:2 +, etc.; Pt. act. קוֹרֵא Amos 5:8 +, קֹרֵא Jeremiah 1:15 +; pl. קֹרִאים Psalms 99:6 (Ges§§ 74 i; 75 oo); pass. קָרוּא Esther 5:12; pl. קְרוּאִים I Samuel 9:22; Ezekiel 23:23, קְרֻאִים I Samuel 9:13 +; cstr. קְרוּאֵי Numbers 1:16 Qr (Kt קריאי), Numbers 26:9 Kt (Qr קְרִיאֵי, v. קָרִיא);—

1. a. call, cry, utter a loud sound, Judges 9:7; II Samuel 18:25 (in v II Samuel 18:28 read וַיִּקְרַב We, confirmed by 𝔊L, so Dr and all recent Comm.), Jeremiah 4:5 Daniel 8:16 (all + אמר), II Kings 7:11 (on text v. Kit Benz), Isaiah 6:4; for help Genesis 39:15, Genesis 39:18 (J); of pleading in court Isaiah 59:4 (ב of manner); explicitly בְּקוֹל גָּדוֹל Genesis 39:14 (J), I Kings 18:27, I Kings 18:28; II Kings 18:28 = Isaiah 36:13 = II Chronicles 32:18, קוֹל גָּדוֹל Ezekiel 9:1 (+ בְּאָזְנֵי); c. אַחֲרֵי pers. I Samuel 20:37 (+ אָמַר), I Samuel 24:8 (Gi; v I Samuel 20:9 van d. H. Baer; + לֵאמֹר), Jeremiah 12:6.

b. call, cry, obj. in orat. recta Judges 7:20 I Samuel 3:4 (read שְׁמוּאֵל שְׁמוּאֵל; 𝔊 Th We Dr Kit Bu HPS), v I Samuel 3:6 (cf. 𝔊), v I Samuel 3:8 (agst. accents), v I Samuel 3:10 (v. שְׁמוּאֵל), I Samuel 20:38; II Samuel 20:16; II Kings 11:14; Jeremiah 20:8; Leviticus 13:45; = utter, speak Jeremiah 36:18; of command Genesis 45:1 (E).

2. a. call unto some one: אֶל pers. (often + אָמַר; sometimes c. מִן loc.), Genesis 3:9; Genesis 19:5; Exodus 3:4 Isaiah 6:3 + often; c. עַל (for אֶל) of satyrs Isaiah 34:14 (so Vrss Ges CheComm. al. > recent Comm. from ii. קָרָא or קָרָה which (in Qal) always take accus.); unto (אֶל) י׳ (God), in praise †Psalms 66:17 I Chronicles 4:10, usually for help, Judges 15:18; I Samuel 12:17, I Samuel 12:18; Hosea 7:7 Psalms 3:5; Psalms 4:4 +, + עַל pers. against Deuteronomy 15:9; Deuteronomy 24:15; to (ל) י׳ (God) †Job 12:4 Psalms 57:3; Psalms 141:1; to (ל) a servant (for service) II Kings 4:36; Job 19:16, so (ל) II Samuel 1:15; call to (ל) one Jeremiah 3:4 (+ orat. rect.), Lamentations 4:15 (id.), Proverbs 2:3 (לְבִינָה); subj. י׳ Micah 6:8; Jeremiah 35:17.

b. cry for help, abs., (poet. and late) Zechariah 7:13; Isaiah 58:9; Isaiah 65:24; Job 5:1; Job 9:16; Proverbs 21:13 Psalms 4:2; Psalms 20:10 + 10 times ψψ (Psalms 147:9 of young ravens); בְּאָזְנֵי Ezekiel 8:18.

c. ק׳ בְּשֵׁם י׳ call with name of י׳ (i.e. use it in invocation): Genesis 4:26; Genesis 12:8; II Kings 5:11; Jeremiah 10:25 = Psalms 79:6 + 16 times (I Kings 18:24 of specif. appeal to י׳ to display his power), + Isaiah 65:1 (v. Pu.); with name of Baal †I Kings 18:24, I Kings 18:25, I Kings 18:26.
d. late, c. acc. dei Isaiah 43:22 Psalms 14:4 + 4 times ψψ; abs. Psalms 116:2.
3. proclaim:

a. c. acc. rei procl. Amos 4:5; Genesis 41:43; Deuteronomy 15:2; Jeremiah 31:6; Leviticus 25:10 +; ק׳ צוֹם proclaim a fast I Kings 21:9, I Kings 21:12 Jeremiah 36:9 +, ק׳ מוֹעֲדֵי י׳ Leviticus 23:2, Leviticus 23:4; ק׳ sq. orat. rect. Exodus 34:6, etc.; sq. ל pers. Jeremiah 34:8, Jeremiah 34:15, Jeremiah 34:17(×2) Isaiah 61:1, עַל pers. (against, concerning) I Kings 13:4, I Kings 13:32; Jeremiah 49:29; Lamentations 1:15; proclaim peace to (ל pers.) Judges 21:13; cf. ק׳ אֵלֶיהָ לְשָׁלוֹם Deuteronomy 20:10; ק׳ c. acc. cogn. מִקְרָא Isaiah 1:13, הַקְרִיאָה Jonah 3:2 (+ אֶל).
b. ק׳ שֵׁם י׳ Deuteronomy 32:3 Psalms 99:6; so (earlier) ק׳ בְשֵׁם י׳ Exodus 33:19; Exodus 34:5 (JE); cf. ק׳ בְּשֵׁם יַעֲקֹב Isaiah 44:5 (but read יִקָּרֵא, Lo Che and most).

c. ק׳ בְּשׁ׳ עֲלֵי Psalms 49:12 proclaim (with) name over landed estates, claim possession (Hup Bae); proclaim one’s own name Ruth 4:11 = become famous; pt. pass. proclaimed, i.e. renowned Ezekiel 23:23.

d. abs. make proclamation (sometimes + אָמַר, לֵאמֹר) Judges 7:3; Jeremiah 2:2 (בְּאָזְנֵי) Zechariah 1:14, Zechariah 1:17; Jonah 3:4; Isaiah 40:3, Isaiah 40:6 +, c. עַל concerning Nehemiah 6:7, against I Kings 13:2 Jonah 1:2.

4. a. read aloud, often בְּאָזְנֵי, less often לִפְנֵי, c. ב of roll, book Jeremiah 36:6, Jeremiah 36:8, Jeremiah 36:14; Nehemiah 8:3, Nehemiah 8:8, Nehemiah 8:18; Nehemiah 9:3; II Chronicles 34:18, + acc. of words Jeremiah 36:8, Jeremiah 36:10; obj. om. Exodus 24:7 (E) Jeremiah 36:15; c. acc. of roll, book v Jeremiah 36:15, Jeremiah 36:21; Jeremiah 51:63; II Kings 22:10; II Chronicles 34:24, of letter (סֵפֶר), writing II Kings 5:7 Isaiah 29:11, Isaiah 29:12; Jeremiah 29:29, columns of manuscript Jeremiah 36:23; c. acc. of words Joshua 8:34, Joshua 8:35; Jeremiah 36:6; Jeremiah 51:61; II Kings 23:2 = II Chronicles 34:30, cf. Deuteronomy 31:11.

b. read, to oneself, in (ב) a roll, book, Deuteronomy 17:19, so of vision written on tablets Habakkuk 2:2; c. acc. of letter (סֵפֶר) II Kings 19:14 = Isaiah 37:14, book II Kings 22:8; abs. Isaiah 34:16.
c. read, for hear read, II Kings 22:16.
5. summon: usually

a. c. ל pers.: Genesis 12:18; Genesis 20:8, Genesis 20:9; Numbers 22:5, Numbers 22:20, Numbers 22:37; Judges 8:1 I Samuel 3:5, I Samuel 3:6, I Samuel 3:8(×2) + often (c. 100 times), + ל reflex. I Kings 1:28, I Kings 1:32, + אֶל loc. Exodus 19:20, + אֶל pers. II Samuel 9:2, + inf. purpose Joshua 24:9; Judges 12:1; Judges 14:15; I Samuel 28:15, + מִן loc. Hosea 11:1 Judges 4:6; + בִּשְׁמֶ֑ךָ Isaiah 45:4 summon by thy name; specif. summon = invite (especially to feast) Exodus 34:15 Judges 14:15 (+ inf. purpose) I Samuel 16:3 (+ בַּזָּבַ֑ח, read prob. לַזּ׳ v. HPS), v I Samuel 16:5 (+ לַזּ׳), I Kings 1:9, I Kings 1:26 + (c. 17 times).

b. c. אֶל pers. Exodus 10:24 Joshua 4:4; Joshua 10:24 I Kings 13:21 + (c. 20 times); אֶל pers. + ל pers. (diff. persons in same relation) Exodus 8:21 Jeremiah 42:8; = call for (demand to see), c. אֶל pers. II Kings 18:18; c. ל rei = demand, require Proverbs 18:6 cf. Proverbs 27:16 (prob. corrupt, v. Toy).

c. c. acc. pers. Genesis 41:8, Genesis 41:14 Exodus 2:7 (+ ל pers.), v Exodus 2:7 Amos 5:16 (+ אֶל rei), Isaiah 13:3 (ל rei), I Samuel 3:16; I Samuel 22:11 + (c. 33 times), ins. וַיִּקְרָא in this sense also II Samuel 15:12 𝔊L We Dr and most; + inf. purpose Numbers 24:10, ק׳ מִמִּזְרָח עַיִט Isaiah 46:11; in weakened sense (to bring response, or bring pers. near) Song of Songs 5:6; specif. invite, I Samuel 9:24 (but corrupt, v. especially HPS), I Kings 1:9 (also + ל, MT), v I Kings 1:10; I Kings 12:20 (+ אֶל loc), Deuteronomy 33:19 (acc. loc.); אֲנִי קָרוּא לָהּ Esther 5:12, pt. pass. elsewhere pl., invited ones, guests I Samuel 9:13, I Samuel 9:22 II Samuel 15:11 I Kings 1:41, I Kings 1:49 Zephaniah 1:7 Proverbs 9:18; invite or summon (acc. pers.) for help, succour, Hosea 7:11; usually obj. י׳ (poet. and late) Jeremiah 29:12 II Samuel 22:4, II Samuel 22:7 = Psalms 18:4, Psalms 18:7 Isaiah 55:6 Lamentations 3:57 Job 27:10 Psalms 50:15; Psalms 86:5 + 8 times ψψ, acc. שֵׁם י׳ Lamentations 3:55; acc. חכמה Proverbs 1:28.

d. abs. call, summon Amos 7:4 (+ ל rei), Isaiah 22:12 (id.), I Samuel 3:5, I Samuel 3:6; Zechariah 7:13; subj. י׳ (God) Isaiah 50:2; Isaiah 65:12; Isaiah 66:4; Job 13:22; Job 14:15, קְרוּאֵי הָעֵדָה Numbers 1:16 Qr (Kt קְרִיאֵי), Numbers 26:9 Kt (Qr קְרִיאֵי!).
e. call and commission, appoint, acc. pers., Isaiah 48:15; Isaiah 49:1, + בְּשֵׁם by name, specifically, Exodus 31:2; Exodus 35:30 Isaiah 43:1; Isaiah 45:3.
f. call and endow (with privilege) Isaiah 51:2; Isaiah 54:6; Isaiah 55:5.
6. call = name:

a. (eárly and most common usage), call one’s name (שֵׁם) so and so, 2 acc.: of pers. Genesis 3:20; Genesis 4:25, Genesis 4:26; Genesis 5:2, Genesis 5:3, Genesis 5:29 + 34 times Gn, Exodus 2:10, Exodus 2:22 Hosea 1:4, Hosea 1:6, Hosea 1:9 Isaiah 7:14; Isaiah 8:3; Isaiah 9:5 + 10 times (Jeremiah 46:17 read קִרְאוּ שֵׁם 𝔊 Gie al.); of places, etc., Genesis 4:17; Genesis 11:9 + 17 times Gn, Judges 1:17, Judges 1:26; Judges 2:5; Judges 15:19; Judges 18:29 + 21 times
b. c. acc. of appellation only, Ezekiel 39:11.
c. acc. pers. vel loc. + acc. appell. Hosea 2:18 Deuteronomy 3:14 Jeremiah 23:6 Isaiah 58:5 Numbers 32:41.
d. acc. pers. + cl. Psalms 89:27.

e. = give name to, acc. appell. + ל pers. (loc., velrei): (1) pers. Hosea 2:18; Genesis 35:18; I Samuel 4:21; Jeremiah 3:19; Jeremiah 30:17; Jeremiah 33:16 + 9 times; (2) loc., vel rei, Judges 18:12 II Samuel 2:16; II Samuel 5:9; II Samuel 6:8 Joshua 22:34 (name lost, 𝔖 Heb. Codd. ins. עֵד; cf. DiSteuern), Genesis 1:5(×2), Genesis 1:8; Genesis 2:19(×2) Exodus 33:7 + 30 times + Job 17:14 (ל + sentence incl. name).
f. c. בְּשֵׁם + ל Isaiah 40:26, cf. Isaiah 65:11 (שֵׁם אַחֵר), Psalms 147:4 (שֵׁמוֹת), Ruth 4:17 (שֵׁם + לֵאמֹר), Genesis 2:20; Genesis 26:18(×2) (all c. שֵׁם).
g. c. ל rei + עַל־שֵׁם II Samuel 18:18.
h. call by (ב) names the names (acc.) of cities Numbers 32:38; call to (ל) city, + appell., + בִּשְׁמוֹ v Numbers 32:42.
i. call cities (acc.) בְּשֵׁם, i.e. specify them, Joshua 21:9; I Chronicles 6:50 (בְּשֵׁמוֹת).

Niph. Pf. 3 ms. נִקְרָא Jeremiah 4:20 +, 1 s. נִקְרֵאתִי Esther 4:11, etc.; Impf. 3 ms. יִקָּרֵא Genesis 2:23 +, וַיִּקָּרֵא Ezekiel 20:29 +, etc.; Pt. נִקְרָא Isaiah 43:7; Jeremiah 44:26; pl. נִקְרָאִים Isaiah 48:1 Esther 6:1;—
1. reflex., מֵעִיר הַקֹּדֶשׁ נִק׳ Isaiah 48:2 from the holy city they call themselves.
2. pass. be called:
a. be proclaimed (cf. Qal 3), of שֵׁם י׳ Jeremiah 44:26 (בְּפֶה instr.); of man’s name = be famous Ruth 4:14; = be announced Jeremiah 4:20.
b. be read aloud (cf. Qal 4): impers. c. ב of book, + בְּאָזְנֵי Nehemiah 13:1; subj. records Esther 6:1 (לִפְנֵי).
c. be summoned (cf. Qal 5): Isaiah 31:4 (עַל against); Esther 3:12; Esther 4:11(×2); Esther 8:9; †בְּשֵׁם, i.e. specifically, Esther 2:14.

d. be named (cf. Qal 6): (1) appell. subj. + ל pers. Genesis 2:23 to her shall be called ‘woman,’ I Samuel 9:9; Isaiah 32:5; Isaiah 62:4, Isaiah 62:12; Proverbs 16:21; + ל loc. II Samuel 18:18; Isaiah 1:26; Isaiah 35:8; Jeremiah 19:6. (2) וְנִקְרָא שְׁמוֹ וגו׳ Deuteronomy 25:10, so Genesis 35:10 Daniel 10:1; Ezekiel 20:29 (of place); אֶת־שִׁמְךָ Ezekiel 20:29. (3) וְנִקְרְאָה יְרוּשׁ׳ וגו׳ Zechariah 8:3, so of land Deuteronomy 3:13, temple Isaiah 56:7. (4) especially נִקְרָא שֵׁם י׳ עַל, denoting ownership, of pers. Jeremiah 15:16, people Deuteronomy 28:10; Jeremiah 14:9; Amos 9:12; Isaiah 63:19; II Chronicles 7:14, ark II Samuel 6:2 (del. 2nd שֵׁם 𝔅 We Dr al.), = I Chronicles 13:6 (adding עָלָיו Oettli Kau; > KitHpt שְׁמוֹ שָׁם), temple I Kings 8:43 = II Chronicles 6:33; Jeremiah 7:10, Jeremiah 7:11, Jeremiah 7:14, Jeremiah 7:30; Jeremiah 32:34; Jeremiah 34:15, city Jeremiah 25:29; Daniel 9:18, city + people v Daniel 9:19; so name of man II Samuel 12:28, as given to his wife Isaiah 4:1. (5) be called עַל שֵׁם, i.e. reckoned to, Genesis 48:6; Isaiah 54:5; Isaiah 61:6; עַל־שֵׁבֶט I Chronicles 23:14, cf. Ezra 2:61 = Nehemiah 7:62. (6) be called בְּשֵׁם Isaiah 43:7; Isaiah 48:1. (7) בְּיִצְחָק יִקּ׳ לְךָ זָ֑רַע Genesis 21:12, i.e. in (through) יִצ׳ shall seed be reckoned to thee; וְיִקָּרֵא בָהֶם שְׁמִי Isaiah 48:16 through them shall my name be called, i.e. perpetuated. (8) be named = mentioned, of pers. Isaiah 14:20. (9) subj. שֵׁם Ecclesiastes 6:10, i.e. thing is known.

Pu. (Ez and Isaiah 2) Pf. 3 ms. קֹרָא be called, subj. appell. + ל pers. vel rei = be named, Isaiah 48:8 Ezekiel 10:13 (קוֹ׳); וְקֹרָא consec. Isaiah 58:12; Isaiah 61:3; Isaiah 62:2 (שֵׁם חָדָשׁ); גּוֹי לֹא קֹרָא בִּשְׁמִי Isaiah 65:1 (< קָרָא or קֹרֵא [Qal 2 c], Vrss Lo Ew Che Di al.); be called and privileged (cf. Qal 5 f), Pt. יִשׂ׳ מְקֹרָאִי Isaiah 48:12.
vb. encounter, befall (‖ form of קָרָה, q.v.; SI 4 לקרת to meet, opposite; Arabic قَرَأَ, put part to part; Min. קרא set opposite, HomChrest. 127);—

Qal Pf.5 3 ms. sf. קְרָאַנִי Jeremiah 13:22 Job 4:2; 3 fs. קָרָאת Deuteronomy 31:29; Jeremiah 44:23, etc.; Impf.4 3 ms. יִקְרָא Genesis 49:1, sf. יִקְרָאֶנּוּ Genesis 42:4; Genesis 42:3 fpl. וַתִּקְרֶאנָה Leviticus 10:19; Exodus 1:10 read 3 fs. sf. תִּקְרָאֵנוּ (Sam Vrss Di Ges§ 47 k SoKau Baen); Inf. cstr.121 לִקְרַאת (Ges§ 19 k Ol§ 137), Genesis 15:10 +, etc.; Pt. fpl. sf. קֹרְאֹתַיִךְ Isaiah 51:19;—

1. meet, encounter, only inf. cstr. לִקְרַאת often = prep. toward, against (Köii. 1, 317), almost always c. acc. pers., after vb. of motion, Isaiah 7:3; Genesis 19:1; Genesis 24:17; Judges 4:18, Judges 4:22; I Kings 2:8 +; in war, battle, Judges 7:24; Judges 20:25, Judges 20:31; I Samuel 4:1; I Kings 20:27 +, after עָרַךְ II Samuel 10:9, II Samuel 10:10, II Samuel 10:17 +, Psalms 35:3 v. I. סגר 2 b; לְחַזֵּק לִבָּם לִק׳ הַמִּלְחָמָה Joshua 11:20 to harden their heart to encounter the war with Isr.; after הִנֵּה (without vb. of motion), †I Samuel 10:10; II Samuel 15:32; II Samuel 16:1; I Kings 18:7; Proverbs 7:10; in constr. prægn. וַיִּשְׂמַח לִק׳ Judges 19:3 he rejoiced to meet him, + I Samuel 6:13 (𝔊 We Dr al.); חרד לִק׳ I Samuel 16:4; I Samuel 21:2; so c. שׁאג Judges 14:5, הריע Judges 15:14, מצא II Kings 10:15, נצב Exodus 5:20; Exodus 7:15 Numbers 22:34, etc.; redund. יִקָּרֶה י׳ לִק׳ Numbers 23:3; implic. of helping, Isaiah 21:14 Psalms 59:5 (fig.); לִק׳ נְחָשִׁים Numbers 24:1 he did not go to encounter (in expectation of) signs of divination; in metaph. Isaiah 14:9, לִק׳ אֱלֹהֶיךָ Amos 4:12.

2. fig. befall c. acc. pers., bad sense Genesis 42:4, Genesis 42:38; Deuteronomy 31:29; Jeremiah 13:22; Jeremiah 44:23; Isaiah 51:19; Job 4:14; Leviticus 10:19; of war Exodus 1:10 (v. supr.); in gen., Genesis 49:1.

Niph. meet unexpectedly; Pf. 3 ms. נִקְרָא, c. עַל pers. Exodus 5:3; Impf. 3 ms. וַיִּקָּרֵא, c. לִפְנֵי pers. II Samuel 18:9; Pf. II Samuel 20:1, c. שָׁם, chanced to be there; Impf. of bird’s nest Deuteronomy 22:6 (לִפְנֵי); Inf. abs. נִקְרֹא v. קרה.
Hiph. Impf. 2 ms. וַתַּקְרֵא Jeremiah 32:23 thou didst cause all this evil to befall them (acc. pers. et rei).
